description: Clock generator with nine outputs, each at its own ratio to the tempo, with its own pulse width and swing

params.text: Sets the tempo, 30 to 240 BPM, shown in the display
Runs the clocks; while it is off every clock output stays at 0V, and switching it on restarts them all together
Restarts every clock together and fires the reset output
Sets the ratio of its clock to the tempo, from sixteen whole notes down to a 128th, shown beside the knob
Sets how far its clock's off beats are pushed late, 0 to 50% of a beat
Sets the pulse width of its clock, 0 to 100% of its period

inputs.text: Runs the clocks while the voltage here is above 0V
A rising edge restarts every clock together and fires the reset output
Sets the tempo as one octave per volt with 0V at 120 BPM, clamped between -2V at 30 BPM and 1V at 240 BPM, and overrides the BPM knob while patched; the README puts 0V at 60 BPM
Sets the pulse width of that clock, 0-10V across the whole range, and overrides the PW knob while patched

outputs.text: Carries 10V while the clocks are running and 0V while they are stopped
A 1ms trigger whenever the clocks are restarted
Carries its clock, 10V while the pulse is high
Carries the tempo as one octave per volt with 0V at 120 BPM

notes: the display under the tempo counts the time the clocks have been running, in minutes, seconds and milliseconds
menu: Accurate — times the pulses from a sample count so they do not drift; turned off, each clock runs from its own phase
Show Time — hides or shows the running time under the tempo
Show Alternative Labels — names each ratio as a multiple of the beat, x4 in place of 1/16

inputs.0: high above 0V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
